items.quote: And Abraham answered and said, Behold now, I have taken upon me to speak unto the LORD, which am but dust and ashes:
items.claim: Abraham speaks to the LORD while calling himself humble, describing himself as 'but dust and ashes'.
items.mechanism: Humble language frames a bold request to God

items.quote: Peradventure there shall lack five of the fifty righteous: wilt thou destroy all the city for lack of five?
items.claim: Abraham asks whether the LORD would destroy the whole city if it had five fewer than the fifty righteous people discussed earlier.
items.action: asks for a lower threshold of righteous people
items.place: the city (not named in this excerpt)
items.mechanism: Bargaining step by step: lowering the number of righteous people needed to spare the city

items.quote: And he said, If I find there forty and five, I will not destroy it.
items.claim: The LORD agrees not to destroy the city if forty-five righteous people are found there.
items.action: promises not to destroy the city if a condition is met
items.place: the city (not named in this excerpt)
items.mechanism: Sparing the city depends on finding at least forty-five righteous people
